test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb4460f483790964680743c5e406ce447a602e7e5a1673f3fa9b3e3281f76533.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The line moves in anticlockwise direction leaving +1 space from the previous step.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1da610392c48edc894e67332291fb734dd8875bfc53e556ea58fc15068b66966.png] 

**Triangle moves in clockwise direction leaving 1 and 2 spaces in alternate step.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4164a3438bf17765ca19d0be8f2692f83f05c94cb9087a27b929e10b33a5c3e.png] 

Next step:

**The line will leave 3 + 1 spaces in the next step to reach center of the right side.**

**The triangle will leave 1 space in the next step to reach top right.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27a2b97bcb1c2530ff0270da152315a3b43e6f8dc0b20dbb7fcd20cb446ff77a.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df7ff9116e3771c0a8afa338a6b062f9ba16c143cd823d78f72131e958a1a2c4.png] Both the triangle and line are placed incorrectly.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9f1278aac9175210bdb930fcba89268e632ad8a67ae46205219e33f0599f30b.png] The line is placed incorrectly.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27a2b97bcb1c2530ff0270da152315a3b43e6f8dc0b20dbb7fcd20cb446ff77a.png] **The pattern is correct.**

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74c78629fb025108a1af34656909c093ac8921ffe80890088a78d81e8a6e275d.png] The line is positioned incorrectly.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
